meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: 它会先把整个代码库梳理成按功能分组的流程图,找出不同功能里重复的代码或逻辑,再提出一套精简的统一架构方案,最后把每个系统的改造计划写成可复制给 /make-plan 的提示。
howto.when: 当你说要找“理想路径”、想把重复的系统统一起来,或在重构前先审查架构时触发。

say.text: 帮我梳理这个代码库,按功能画出流程图。
say.note: 它会启动功能发现并产出各功能的 Mermaid 流程图。

say.text: 找出不同功能里重复的代码,给出统一方案。
say.note: 它会做重复项排查并写一份统一架构提案。

say.text: 重构前先审计下整体架构,列出要合并的系统。
say.note: 它会产出重复报告与可执行的改造计划提示。

howto.what_en: It maps the codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identifies duplicated logic across features, proposes a simplified unified architecture, and ends with per-system prompts ready to paste into /make-plan. It does not write implementation code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to find the ideal path, unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor.

say_en.text: Map this codebase and draw flowcharts grouped by feature.
say_en.note: It starts feature discovery and outputs Mermaid flowcharts.

say_en.text: Find duplicated code across features and propose a unified design.
say_en.note: It runs the duplication hunt and writes a unified proposal.

say_en.text: Audit the overall architecture before refactoring and list systems to consolidate.
say_en.note: It produces a duplication report and handoff prompts.
